Package io.github.kimbongjune.geoserverclient.dto.security

Class UserGroupServiceConfig

java.lang.Object
io.github.kimbongjune.geoserverclient.dto.security.UserGroupServiceConfig
public class UserGroupServiceConfig extends Object
DTO for a GeoServer user/group service configuration. Maps GET/POST/PUT /rest/security/usergroupservices.

getConfigClass() is the JSON envelope key (filter type FQCN), getClassName() is the service implementation FQCN. The most common type (XML-backed) is covered by xml(java.lang.String, java.lang.String, long, boolean, java.lang.String, java.lang.String). LDAP/JDBC and other types use getExtra() for type-specific fields.

  • Method Details

    • xml

      public static UserGroupServiceConfig xml(String name, String fileName, long checkInterval, boolean validating, String passwordEncoderName, String passwordPolicyName)
      Factory for an XML-backed User/Group Service (the GeoServer default type).
      Parameters:
      name - service name
      fileName - XML backing file (e.g. users.xml)
      checkInterval - file reload interval in ms (0 = no polling)
      validating - whether to validate the XML on load
      passwordEncoderName - password encoder bean name (e.g. digestPasswordEncoder)
      passwordPolicyName - password policy bean name (e.g. default)
